events.description: All-Ages Karaoke Night at the Helios Ballroom Presented by Snohomish Block Party Nonprofit All-Ages Karaoke Night is a fun, welcoming space for everyone to sing, cheer and enjoy the music. It’s especially popular with the 7–18 crowd, with lots of young performers bringing big energy and confidence to the stage. Grab a song, take the mic and join the fun! 🎤 Location: Helios Ballroom, 213 Ave D, Sn
